# Booster — company transformation with AI

> Booster helps mid-sized B2B companies (50–300 people) move from scattered AI use, where every employee has their own chatbot, to one system the whole company works on: shared data, ordered processes and AI agents working on company data. We build on Open Mercato, an open-source framework for business systems, and work in stages with a fixed price for each stage. The code and the data stay with the client. Based in Wrocław, Poland.

- After the first call the client gets a staged plan with the price of the first stage
- No per-user fees; the code is open, so another team could continue without us
- Systems run on the client's servers or in the cloud, on leading AI models or on open models such as Bielik
- We also implement on Monday, ClickUp and Pipedrive
- Contact: hello@boosterai.pl
- Book a free call: https://boosterai.pl/en/book (Polish: https://boosterai.pl/pl/book)

## Services

- [AI automation](https://boosterai.pl/en/practices/ai-automation): Automating repetitive processes on the company's own data, data first, AI second.
- [Custom B2B software](https://boosterai.pl/en/practices/b2b-software): Software built for one company's process, with the code owned by the client.
- [CRM implementation](https://boosterai.pl/en/practices/crm-implementation): CRM set up around how the sales team actually works.
- [ERP and CRM on Open Mercato](https://boosterai.pl/en/practices/open-source-erp): An open-source company system without per-user fees.

## Work

- [LegalFlow](https://legal-flow.pl): Our own platform for Polish restructuring law firms, in production. Up to 70% less administrative work.
- [Certificates for posted workers](https://boosterai.pl/en#work): A group of four construction companies. Monthly certificate data for about 300 workers is now one click plus checking exceptions; 99.8% match with manual work on historical data.
- [AI agent that finds new clients](https://boosterai.pl/en#work): An engineering contractor. An AI agent suggests potential clients to the sales team.
- [Sales proposal automation](https://boosterai.pl/en#work): A large media company. Preparing sales proposals is automated.
